tool_args.rationale: The pilot shows positive short-horizon gain, while the paid H=20 measurement is negative. Fit the archived dual-exponential adaptation law numerically and test it on fresh confirmation; the slow timescale may remain weakly identified away from the observed horizons.

considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The acquired H=20 observation already establishes a negative response at the target horizon and anchors the proposed model there.
The six observations can fit the four-parameter adaptation law; a fresh confirmation is the cheaper next test of its target-horizon predictions.

considered_alternatives.option: coupled memory ODE and damped oscillator
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: They are alternatives, but the observed short positive response and long-horizon reversal match the archived adaptation mechanism directly.
The static siphon branch does not explain the observed horizon-dependent reversal.
